svg.text: Two-node Raft HA: schema and data replication

g.text: 2 ArcadeDB containers on one Docker network, all given the same Raft server list.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Database and schema are written through the leader, which Raft carries to every follower.
CREATE VERTEX TYPE User, Photo - EDGE TYPE HasUploaded, FriendOf, Likes - UNIQUE_HASH / FULL_TEXT / GEOSPATIAL
Both nodes are asked for the schema: the follower must report the five types, not just the leader.
Ten users, each with ten photos, are written to the leader - one locked transaction per vertex.
BEGIN; LOCK TYPE User, Photo, HasUploaded; CREATE VERTEX ...; CREATE EDGE HasUploaded; COMMIT RETRY 30;
Both nodes are polled once a second until the follower's counts equal the leader's.
until(() -> users2 == users1 && photos2 == photos1) atMost 30s, pollInterval 1s
Converged counts are not enough: both nodes are asserted against the absolute expected totals.
